meta.title: About Chimera — Built by people who believe your money should belong to you
meta.description: Chimera Wallet holds no funds, takes no spread, and sells no order flow. Open source, browser-based, built on Chimera. Freedom the way it should be.

hero.title:
BUILT BY PEOPLE

WHO BELIEVE YOUR MONEY

SHOULD BELONG TO YOU.
hero.subtitle: We write open-source code for people who understand that their money should belong to them. No shareholders. No venture capital. No one to answer to except the mission.
hero.body: Everything we build is published openly, auditable by anyone, free to fork. Financial services are provided by regulated third parties. We don't hold your funds. The architecture makes it impossible.

items.title: OPEN SOURCE.
items.body: Every line published. No black boxes. Code that belongs to everyone who uses it.

items.title: NON-CUSTODIAL BY DESIGN.
items.body: Not a policy that can change. Not a promise that can be broken.

items.title: SWISS NON-PROFIT ASSOCIATION.
items.body: No extraction. No VC pressure. A legal structure built to align with the mission, not against it.

items.title: SELF-SOVEREIGNTY.
items.body: The word the financial system has spent decades trying not to normalise. We're normalising it — one wallet at a time.
